## Proposed change
Every prometheus metric has at least 3 labels (`entity`, `name`, `domain`).
If a user changes the `friendly_name` a new metric is created, but the old one keeps existing. This was reported in #50382.
This also happens when an entity id is renamed and by deleting or disabling an entity.

In this pull request the `EVENT_ENTITY_REGISTRY_UPDATED` event is used to listen to the changes and to remove the non-existing labelsets.
To remove a labelset the function has to iterate over all labelsets. Since this only happens when an entity is renamed, disabled or deleted this shouldn't make a difference in performance.

issue_context.title: Prometheus api exposes duplicate metrics after rename object
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Prometheus api exposes duplicate metrics after rename object. 

When you change `friendly_name` of object, Prometheus endpoint expose two metrics instead one. 
One with old `friendly_name` and one with new `friendly_name`. 

Duplicate metrics affects Grafana dashboards, in this case dashboard shows two metrics. 
Old metric (with old `friendly_name`) - looks like value for metrics just hang and 
new metric with valid values. See screenshot.

After restart `Home-Assisatant` issue gone. Endpoint again expose correct number of metrics for object. 
(gaps is restarts on screenshot)

![Prom_api](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6247921/117594905-dfc5ab00-b147-11eb-989f-9a4683e416bf.png)


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.5.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Prometheus

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/prometheus/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
...
prometheus:
  namespace: hass
...
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

_No response_

Issue still present and repeatable. After renaming a friendly-name the home-assistent reports two different metrics to prometheus until restart.

The problem occurs because the old label set of the metric is not removed. A label set consists of `entity`, `domain`, `friendly_name` and optional `extra_labels`
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/93ad48643916a22dd717738ad0b0c9bf74b92d11/homeassistant/components/prometheus/__init__.py#L241-L246

The `prometheus` integration subscribes to `EVENT_STATE_CHANGED` and could recognize a change of the `friendly_name` by comparing `old_state` and `new_state`.

Since `handle_event(self, event)` only forwards `new_state`, the handler function can't know if a change occurred.
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/93ad48643916a22dd717738ad0b0c9bf74b92d11/homeassistant/components/prometheus/__init__.py#L149-L152

And `handle_event(self, event)` doesn't know the metric name and `extra_labels`, because the handler function doesn't return them.


@knyar Would it be ok to also pass the `new_state`?
If yes, something like this could be added to the handler functions:
```python
def _remove_duplicate_label(event, extra_labels):
      if event.data.get("old_state").attributes.get(ATTR_FRIENDLY_NAME) != event.data.get("new_state").attributes.get(ATTR_FRIENDLY_NAME):
           metric.remove(**dict(self._labels(event.data.get("old_state"), extra_labels))
```

Thanks for reporting this! This is indeed a side effect of how Prometheus client library works: once created a metric will keep being exported until it's explicitly deleted, or when a process restarts.

I think it's a sensible proposal to add detection of renamed (and perhaps deleted?) entities and explicitly remove metrics associated with them. It might require keeping track of exported metrics per entity, since some metric names are dynamically generated (for sensors, I believe).

I'll be happy to review a PR for this. Note that this will probably need a few tests added to confirm that metrics for obsolete entities get deleted, but existing metrics stay intact (it would be bad if we accedentally started deleting and recreating metrics without it being necessary).
I have a pull request that fixes renaming and deleting entities. I am just waiting for #60451 to be merged before submitting it.
Any idea when this will go to a release?

review_comments: Again, perhaps this can be simplified with a broader check, like `assert 'friendly_name="Outside Humidity"' in '\n'.join(body)`?

This would stop at the first match. If one of the metrics would be deleted by mistake, the test wouldn't notice it.
On the other hand we're not checking every metric for `sensor.outside_humidity` at the moment anyway.
Should I change it regardless?
Oh yes, you are right, it's safer to have more specific checks here.
